sections.h2: The 2026 window drew $133 billion, nearly five times the 2013 scheme

chart.title: The 2026 FCNR(B) inflow is nearly five times the 2013 scheme's
chart.sub: US$ billion of FCNR(B) deposits mobilised.
chart.source: RBI figures as cited in the post.

sections.means: Banks swapped about $133 billion of three-to-five-year dollar deposits with the RBI by 18 September ($127.2 billion at the 31 August close), against about $27 billion of FCNR(B) money in 2013.
sections.todo: Publish the tenor mix of the deposits and the renewal assumptions, which the post says are not public.

sections.h2: Reserves fell $51.1 billion in the four weeks after their 4 September peak

chart.title: Reserves peaked at $785.7 billion, then fell four weeks in a row
chart.sub: Weekly forex reserves, US$ billion, week ending as shown.
chart.source: RBI weekly figures as cited in the post.

sections.means: Reserves reached a record $785.7 billion on 4 September and then fell in four straight weeks to $734.6 billion.
sections.todo: Report the split of weekly reserve changes between dollar sales and revaluation, which the RBI does not publish.

sections.h2: The RBI's net short dollar forward book rose to $200.1 billion by end-August

chart.title: The short forward book rose $63.3 billion in the single month to August
chart.sub: RBI net short dollar forward book at month end, US$ billion.

sections.means: Each swap adds to the RBI's short position in dollar forwards, so the book grew from $136.8 billion to $200.1 billion in one month.
sections.todo: Publish the maturity profile of the forward book each month so the repayments created by the swaps can be tracked.
